required_tables.commit: KFD events are stored in the generic regions view, filtered by category
required_tables.name: regions

validation_queries.description: Check that KFD page migration events exist
validation_queries.error_message: No KFD page migration events found in regions

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have valid timestamps
validation_queries.error_message: No migration events with valid timestamps found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_kfd_page_migrate' AND start > 0

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have positive duration
validation_queries.error_message: No migration events with positive duration found
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_kfd_page_migrate' AND duration > 0

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have src_agent args
validation_queries.error_message: Migration events missing src_agent in args
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra.id) FROM region_args ra WHERE ra.name = 'src_agent' AND ra.id IN (SELECT r.id FROM {table_name} r WHERE r.category = 'rocm_kfd_page_migrate')

validation_queries.description: Check that migration events have dst_agent args
validation_queries.error_message: Migration events missing dst_agent in args
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ra.id) FROM region_args ra WHERE ra.name = 'dst_agent' AND ra.id IN (SELECT r.id FROM {table_name} r WHERE r.category = 'rocm_kfd_page_migrate')

validation_queries.description: If page faults exist, check they have valid timestamps
validation_queries.error_message: Page fault events found but with invalid timestamps
validation_queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_kfd_page_fault') = 0 THEN 1 ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {table_name} WHERE category = 'rocm_kfd_page_fault' AND start > 0) END
